title: CABAL: Revolution officially launches, bringing a new era of cross-country MMORPG competition to Southeast Asia
summary: The wait is finally over as Combo Interactive officially launches CABAL: Revolution on November 19, introducing a new seasonal server experience that brings together MMORPG enthusiasts from Thailand,…

blocks.text: The wait is finally over as Combo Interactive officially launches CABAL: Revolution on November 19, introducing a new seasonal server experience that brings together MMORPG enthusiasts from Thailand, the Philippines, Indonesia, Malaysia, and Singapore.

After weeks of anticipation and growing discussions across the gaming community, CABAL: Revolution is set to deliver a renewed experience for fans of the classic MMORPG franchise. With its competitive gameplay, player-driven economy, and unified Southeast Asian server, the game aims to bring players from different countries together in one competitive environment.
Play Over Pay

In CABAL: Revolution, players earn Combat Power through gameplay. As they take on challenges and develop their characters, the progress they make in-game is what makes them stronger. Spending plays a limited role in character progression, and players can reach high Combat Power without spending any money.
Even in the CBT, players managed to break through the 1 million Combat Power through gameplay only.
Southeast Asia Prepares for an Intense PvP Rivalry

Among the countries expected to make a strong impact are Thailand and the Philippines, alongside competitive communities from Indonesia and other SEA territories. Even during the CBT the tension between nations was high, as Thailand dominated the Nation Wars up until the final days.

Thailand, in particular, enters the competition with considerable momentum following its recent championship victory at CABALFest 2026. With that achievement behind them, Thai players are expected to defend their regional reputation as they face challengers from across Southeast Asia.

The shared server environment adds another layer of excitement, as players will no longer be competing within isolated country-based communities. Instead, they will face one another directly, creating opportunities for rivalries, alliances, and intense cross-country encounters.
Every Guild Has a Story. Forge Yours in CABAL Revolution.

In CABAL Revolution, guilds give players a place to find teammates, share advice, and take on challenges together. New players can learn from experienced guildmates, while veterans can help others develop their characters and build a regular group to play with.

Those connections grow through everyday moments, from helping a guildmate through a difficult fight to celebrating a hard-earned victory together. For players joining with friends or meeting their guildmates for the first time, guilds make it easier to find a community they want to keep playing with. From the CBT many have forged the bonds and are now moving forward with them into the official Launch.
A Unified Marketplace Driven by Players

Another defining feature of CABAL: Revolution is its unified player marketplace, which connects the economies of participating Southeast Asian countries. Having already thousands of dollars being offered in the CBT Phase, it only shows that there will be more to be offered during the official release!

Players themselves determine the value of items through supply and demand, making the marketplace an important part of the overall game experience. Whether farming valuable equipment, collecting resources, or searching for rare drops, every player has a role in shaping the in-game economy.

The competition is therefore not limited to Mission War and PvP encounters. The marketplace itself becomes another arena where players compete through smart trading, resource management, and economic strategy.
